W2 (empirical), after E011. Best: E010, 6.639 s, 0.7548 (8.5 ep, Muon+EMA+prog-res 24/28/32, last width 512). Margin over the 0.753 bar is 0.17 pp.

Measured (3 seeds, all complete): E001 9ep eager 0.7430/9.43. E004 compiled 0.7486/9.04. E005 +EMA 0.7583/9.10. E006 +Muon 0.7649/9.45. E007 +prog-res 0.7590/7.33. E008 8.5ep 0.7572/6.98. E009 LR floor 0 0.7564/6.99. E010 width 512 0.7548/6.64. E011 aggressive res (20/24/28/32) 0.7451/5.70.

Mechanisms:
1. Epoch dial: -0.5 epoch costs about 0.18 pp and saves 4.8% time (E007 to E008). Roughly linear.
2. Compile: E003's slowness was a recompile leak. E004 fixed it with stride matching; compile alone saved about 4%.
3. EMA: +0.97 pp for +0.06 s (E004 to E005). Cheapest gain measured.
4. Muon: +0.66 pp for +0.35 s (E005 to E006).
5. Progressive resizing: -22% time for -0.59 pp (E006 to E007). Time tracks pixel count.
6. Width 576 to 512: -4.8% time for -0.25 pp, about the same exchange rate as the epoch dial.
7. LR floor 0 on top of EMA: no gain (-0.08 pp, E009). EMA and the low final LR are redundant.
8. Resolution cliff (E011): -14% time for -1.4 pp, about 3x worse than E007's exchange rate. The 20 px phase is costly.
9. Noise: 3-seed accuracy about ±0.2 pp; time about 1%. Fixed costs about 0.3-0.5 s.

Misses: I under-predicted EMA, Muon and resizing, and over-predicted E009. I lean pessimistic on accuracy gains from changes that were measured to help.

Unsure: GPU idle time and launch overhead under 4 CPUs (CUDA graphs could save 0-10%). Also unsure whether lr, wd and label smoothing are tuned for CIFAR-100, and the held-out seed spread. The margin is thin, so accuracy-neutral systems changes are the only safe time wins. Any accuracy-positive tweak could be spent on epochs, at about 0.18 pp per 4.8% of time.

forecasts.reason: Launch overhead is unmeasured; at batch 2000 compute likely dominates, so the saving is probably under 7%. Capture complexity may also break.
Diagnostic with no recipe change. The 10-seed mean should sit near 0.7545, but the margin is thin.
LS 0.3 is high for 100 classes with EMA, so a small gain is plausible. The effect is within noise.
Muon lr was never tuned here. Either direction is plausible and the gain is probably small.
Wd is probably near flat for a short run, and Muon normalizes weight norms anyway. Difference within noise.
The code already uses 3 NS steps, so the idea is nearly a no-op. Changing to fewer steps would save up to 1-2% time at a small accuracy cost.
Removing syncs gives a small saving if any exist. Math is identical, so accuracy stays flat.
E005 shows endpoint averaging matters. Plain EMA without reset is probably a bit weaker in a 8.5-epoch run.

cruxes: How much GPU idle or launch overhead is there per step under the 4-CPU pin? A large fraction would make CUDA graphs a big lossless win; a small one would not.
What is the 40-seed mean of the E010 recipe? If it falls well under 0.75, the margin has to be rebuilt and epochs cannot be cut further.
Is any of label smoothing, Muon lr or weight decay mistuned by at least 0.3 pp? That accuracy could be spent on epochs, at about 0.18 pp per 4.8% of time.
